text: #968, built by hand: a built-in check that selects internal/dashboard gets internal/factory's and internal/plumbing's budget, 25 minutes of tests inside a 30-minute run. Since #944 the package's whole suite takes more than the ordinary ten minutes in the sandbox: #963's build passed all eight acceptance tests but its check ran out while TestProjection944SavedQuestionRecovery was still running.
